subject: Exciting New Job Opportunity at ABC Company
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I am pleased to inform you about a new job opening at ABC Company for the position of Marketing Specialist. Your experience and skills align perfectly with the requirements for this role, and we believe you would be a great fit for our team. Please find attached the job description for more details. We look forward to receiving your application. Best regards, [Sender]
